title: Only the ladder names a stage
rationale: The Driver Engine 0-5 ladder is the only ladder allowed to name a stage; rival ladder vocabularies are parked and must not be used as stages or promotion gates.
fix: Use the configured ladder label for that stage number (see config/ladder.json), or describe the behaviour instead of naming a stage.
